findings.finding: The applies_when value for the new project move is never defined. The plan specifies adding a move to plan_review_moves.json with an applies_when field, but does not specify what tag(s) it should contain. For plan-review, applicable_moves() filters using active_triggers = the union of criteria[] from surviving findings — so if applies_when is set to ["project.symbol-reference-completeness"], the move only appears when that criterion has already surfaced a finding (which is correct behavior). If applies_when is omitted or empty, the move is always-applicable (appears for every coachable finding regardless of criterion). This is a processing-protocol/decision-rule gap: an executor writing the move entry has no specified value to use, and the two options produce materially different coach behavior.
